game.title: Gears 5
game.blurb: Third-person cover shooter from The Coalition, released 2019-09-10. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Campaign Act 1
chapters.summary: The four chapters of the first act, from Boot Camp onward, each with a story milestone.

chapters.title: Campaign Act 2
chapters.summary: The five chapters of the second act, through the valley and the comm towers. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Campaign Act 3
chapters.summary: The four chapters of the third act, around the satellites and the rocket. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Campaign Act 4 and the Ending
chapters.summary: The last two chapters and finishing all acts. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Jack, Relics, Collectibles and Difficulty
chapters.summary: Jack's abilities and upgrades, Relic weapons, Condor supplies, all collectibles, co-op, Insane, Ironman and Inconceivable runs.

chapters.title: Hivebusters Expansion
chapters.summary: The Hivebusters campaign: its chapters, each character's ability, collectibles, Insane and three-player co-op.

chapters.title: Horde and Escape
chapters.summary: Horde waves, Horde Frenzy, Escape hives, the map builder and class levels in both modes.

chapters.title: Versus and Arcade
chapters.summary: Versus maps, Arcade, Arcade Blitz, Free For All, Gridiron, 2vs2 Gnashers, Ranked and Competitive play.

chapters.title: Tour of Duty, Re-ups and Cosmetics
chapters.summary: Tour of Duty ranks, re-ups, skill cards, skins, the Seriously 5.0 goals and class levels.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1097840)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (gearsofwar.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://gearsofwar.fandom.com/wiki/Gears_5
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has no page under "Gears 5" or "Gears of War 5". gearsofwar.fandom.com answers the API under "Gears 5" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema gives no game name for app 1097840; the store list confirms it. 6 of 181 Steam achievements are hidden; their API names are DLC_Campaign_1 to DLC_Campaign_6, so they sit in the Hivebusters chapter (the expansion name comes from RAWG, which lists "Gears 5: Hivebusters", and from achievement descriptions). The four act chapters use the Steam API names Act1Chapter1StoryPoint to Act4Chapter2StoryPoint, placed by exact name; "My Body is Ready" (Complete Boot Camp) was put with Act 1 as a guess. Many achievements name post-launch Operations (2 to 8) and their maps and characters; they are grouped by mode (Horde and Escape, Versus) rather than by Operation. Leftover achievements with no mode named (class levels, "Sire, Interrupted", "A Good Plan, Violently Executed", the Scorcher kill) sit in the progression chapter. Over a hundred achievements are below 3% on Steam, so a full list is a very long grind.
